rationale: Although EQX gapped up on high relative volume and holds above VWAP ($10.23) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($10.24), intraday momentum has stalled into a 1-cent range ($10.26–$10.27) on rapidly declining 1-minute volume during the midday session.
